selection.description: First eligible event per distinct current KRW market, chronological; same-day ties by prior-20-day median KRW turnover descending then market name. No future return filter.
selection.price_features: MACD histogram acceleration > 0; RSI and Williams velocity > 0 and acceleration > 0
selection.caveat: Provisional entry proxy; numeric thresholds are research assumptions. Current market list creates survivorship coverage limits. Not a validated detector backtest.

policy.entry_reference: First five-minute open at D+1 daily boundary
policy.execution: Decide only after a complete candle; sell at next contiguous five-minute open reference with cost scenario. No fills at stop/high or same-bar favorable ordering.
policy.A: At least two of MACD histogram, RSI14, Williams14 daily first differences are negative
policy.B: A AND daily close strictly below previous daily low

C.trigger: completed five-minute close at or below running-high trail

D.trigger: completed five-minute close at or below non-decreasing running-high minus prior-completed-bar ATR trail

policy.terminal_rule: Uniform five-day study endpoint liquidates any remaining case position for comparison; not an approved operating holding limit.
policy.cost_caveat: Scenario only; no authenticated fees, historical book depth or execution latency.

execution_notes.timing: Defined after data coverage checks and before the first return calculation.
execution_notes.reason: Upbit omits 5-minute candles with no trades. Every observed daily OHLCV aggregate matches its independent daily candle. Empty buckets are not filled with synthetic trade prices.
execution_notes.supersedes: The word contiguous in policy.json execution wording does not apply to no-trade gaps.
execution_notes.effective_execution: After a completed signal candle or daily boundary, use the first actual five-minute candle at or after the decision time, and only its opening price. Its precise first-trade timestamp and order-book depth are unavailable. Record bucket-level execution delay.
execution_notes.atr: ATR14 is computed on the 14-period sequence of actual Upbit 5-minute candles. Its wall-clock span can exceed 70 minutes. Use only ATR from before the just-completed signal candle; never add flat synthetic candles.
execution_notes.unchanged: Sample selection, entry rules, A/B/C/D thresholds, activation, horizon and costs remain exactly as frozen before data collection.

caveats: 10 correlated cases in one month are exploratory, not statistical proof.
Not an approved entry detector or executable strategy.
Current-list survivorship and data failure coverage limits.
5m next-open cost scenario; no historical order-book or latency reconstruction.
Full-window peak is hindsight comparison only, never a signal input.
Uniform endpoint exit is a study convention; no common protective stop.
